snippet.title: Walk The Frog - LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
Go get the game or add to your wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336240/Walk_The_Frog/

Walk The Frog is finally OUT NOW on Steam for PC/Mac and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you! Step into the cozy narrative puzzle game where every level is built from hand drawn sticky notes. Rebuild Froggo’s world, solve relaxing drag and drop puzzles and guide him back home to meet his best friend buddy.
